criteria.evidence: Turn 0 proposal covers collateral, hand removal between runs, CHANGE/overwrite marks, apt-mark auto, flatpak scope mismatch, derived classes, with a general existence-probe rule.
Replay said `gh` isn't installed and no remote; wrote issue text to .planning/.../02-ISSUE-stale-machine-specific-marks.md with a `gh issue create` command to file it.
New tests `test_a_mark_this_run_removed_is_forgotten_in_the_same_run` and `TestTheUatCaseEndToEnd::test_the_mark_does_not_outlive_the_collateral_removal` pass in final run (4609 passed).

Final message reports DecisionFile.forget, load_live_decisions at plan time, post-converge target re-probe, dry-run/fail-closed/derived-class guards, docs (requirements, conformance article, ADR D-43, matrix H181–H212, runbook) all implemented; user doc states item becomes an ordinary difference again.
tests/unit/jobs/test_mark_forgetting.py with 35 tests mapped to matrix rows H181–H212 covering every scenario; test_scenario_coverage_matrix.py passes.

ruff check/format, codespell, basedpyright clean; pytest 4609 passed with the only failure an rsync-missing FileNotFoundError in test_apt_etc_apt.py, unrelated to the diff and explained as environmental.
Runbook diff adds `grep -c fortunes ... # 0 — the mark did not outlive the package` on pc2 and rewrites the §4 setup/§6 prose to say pc2's record of fortunes is gone with the package.

judge.reason: The replay produced a general proposal, an issue draft when GitHub was unreachable, and implemented the full rule with per-manager probes, guards, docs and 35 scenario tests, with all repo checks clean except one pre-existing rsync-missing test it identified as environmental. Minor doubt remains over a small deviation from the proposal's edge-case list (bogus-id entries kept rather than pruned) that was not called out explicitly, though it is outside the parts c4 names.
